title: Fix VIES integrity check: tolerate country-code prefix on echoed VAT number (uptake fix)
summary: The VIES integrity check for VAT numbers now tolerates country-code prefixes in echoed responses, normalizing both sides before comparison to prevent false rejection of valid VAT numbers during registration.
key_points: Fixed a regression where VIES responses that echo the VAT number with its country-code prefix were wrongly rejected as mismatches
Both the request and response numbers are stripped of the prefix before the integrity check compares them
Removes the hard block on saving a VAT Registration No., because the check runs in its OnValidate
Numbers or countries that really differ are still rejected
Fixes 10 failing tests in codeunit 134192, which run only in NAV uptake with a mock service
